intro_body: It searches company career pages directly — the same ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters) a company posts to before a role ever reaches LinkedIn or a public job board. Every posting is automatically scored against your resume, and your resume and application questions can be pre-filled without you lifting a finger. Passing jobs show up ready-to-apply on your Dashboard, usually while the listing is still fresh — before most candidates even find it.
step1_hint: Search runs only against the job boards listed below - not general job sites.
site_pool_tooltip: Write a normal Google-style query: quotes for an exact phrase, OR to combine terms, site:<board> to target one specific board from the list below.
custom_queries_toggle_sub: Not required - the toggle above already searches everything. Use this only to target specific job titles instead.
custom_queries_disabled_hint: Turn off "Catch everything" above to use this.
query_input_placeholder: Write or paste a full search query, e.g. (site:boards.greenhouse.io OR site:jobs.lever.co) (AI OR LLM) (Engineer OR Developer)
query_limit_reached_hint: word limit reached for this query
no_saved_queries: No saved queries yet - add one above, or let AI suggest some from your resume.
step2_hint: A fast, lenient pass over search-result titles/snippets before scraping, to skip the obviously irrelevant ones.
min_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or above this are marked "passed" and move on to the next steps.
max_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or below this are considered a clear miss.
auto_archive_tooltip: Otherwise they're just flagged, not hidden.
step4_hint: Runs automatically for a level below only if at least one change type in it is checked to auto-apply.
change_type_title_tooltip: Changes the main headline under your name (e.g. your title/specialization).
change_type_company_name_tooltip: Only reworks how a role's job title is phrased under an experience entry - not the company name, not the main headline.
change_type_skills_tooltip: Reorders and rephrases the skills list, using only skills already present in your resume.
change_type_summary_tooltip: Rewrites the summary paragraph to foreground experience relevant to this posting.
change_type_bullet_tooltip: Targeted edits to experience bullets/paragraphs, weaving in the posting's keywords without inventing anything.
step5_tooltip: Every passing job automatically gets an application with these questions pre-answered, attached to it.
step5_hint: Runs automatically whenever this list isn't empty.
base_question_placeholder: e.g. Describe a project you're proud of
catch_all_tooltip: Ignores the saved query pool below and runs one query that just asks for every posting on the boards you have configured, with no title filter. Simpler, fewer Serpent calls, and misses nothing your quick-filter/evaluator will screen anyway.
max_pages_tooltip: How deep to page into a query's results (100 results per page). If a query returns a full page, the next page is fetched automatically until this limit or the results run out.
num_per_query_tooltip: How many results the search provider returns per query (max 100).
run_failed_toast: Run failed, see history for details.
queries_dropped_toast: Skipped (too many words even after trimming)
